text: If the power of all deities were to manifest as one form, how powerful would that form be?
What is the specialty of Mahachandi Devi?
In the Devi Mahatmyam, there is an episode where all the deities, unable to withstand the oppression of Mahishasura, united, and a great power emerged from their effulgences.
The deities offered their weapons to that Devi.
The power of each deity… manifested as one great power.
Here lies a great sentiment, the Mother Goddess manifested as a form where all the powers of the deities united to confront unrighteousness.
The great form where all divine powers unite for the protection of Dharma.
